LESSON: GUIDED READING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: READING Theme 7. My Body
Topic 2.8: Guided reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided reading, part of READING Theme 7. My Body in Grade 4 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: Why is reading important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read a chart with the illustrations of weather features and their names out loud,

2. match pictures of weather features with their names and read them out loud,

3. read texts on weather features and answer given questions,

4. take photos of weather features with peers, label them and present in plenary.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read a chart with the illustrations of weather features and their names out loud,
2. match pictures of weather features with their names and read them out loud,
3. read texts on weather features and answer given questions,
4. take photos of weather features with peers, label them and present in plenary.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital literacy: The learner develops the skill of creating new content with technology when they take photos of weather

features with peers, label them and present them in plenary.

Values:
Unity: The learner works collaboratively with peers as they take photos of weather features with peers, label them and

present them in plenary.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental education: The learner develops environmental awareness when they name weather features.

Link to other learning areas

The learner links the concept of weather features to the same concept in Social Studies.
